claims.claim_text: IonQ acquired Oxford Ionics Limited in September 2025 for approximately $1.6B purchase consideration, with $422.9M of acquired developed-technology intangible assets.
claims.subject: IonQ
claims.source_quote: the Company acquired Capella and Oxford Ionics on July 11, 2025 and September 16, 2025, respectively for purchase consideration of approximately $424.8 million and $1.6 billion, respectively.

claims.claim_text: IonQ entered into a $1.8B definitive agreement to acquire SkyWater Technology, a US-based semiconductor foundry, on January 25, 2026.
claims.subject: IonQ
claims.object_value: SkyWater Technology, Inc.; ~$1.8B cash-and-stock; announced Jan 25-26, 2026
claims.source_quote: On January 25, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to acquire SkyWater Technology, Inc. (SkyWater), a U.S.-based semiconductor foundry, for total consideration of approximately $1.8 billion in a cash-and-stock transaction.

claims.claim_text: IonQ reported GAAP revenue of $130.0M for FY2025, up from $43.1M in FY2024 (3.0x).
claims.subject: IonQ

claims.claim_text: IonQ acquired id Quantique SA, Vector Atomic Inc., Capella Space Corp., Lightsynq Technologies in 2025 and Skyloom Global Corp. in January 2026, building a 'quantum networking, sensing and security' platform.
claims.subject: IonQ
claims.object_value: id Quantique (QKD); Vector Atomic (quantum sensing); Capella (SAR satellites); Lightsynq (photonic interconnect); Skyloom (optical comms); Seed Innovations
claims.source_quote: We also cemented our leadership in quantum networking, quantum sensing and quantum security with our acquisitions of id Quantique SA, Vector Atomic, Inc., Capella Space Corp. in 2025, and of Skyloom Global Corp. in January 2026.

claims.claim_text: Net loss attributable to IonQ was $510.4M in 2025 (vs $331.6M in 2024 and $157.8M in 2023); accumulated deficit $1,194.1M as of Dec 31, 2025; net cash used in operations $283.2M in 2025.
claims.subject: IonQ
claims.object_value: FY25 net loss $510.4M; accum deficit $1.194B; opex cash burn $283.2M
claims.source_quote: Our net losses attributable to IonQ, Inc. were $510.4 million, $331.6 million and $157.8 million, for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $1,194.1 million.
